title: Off-Plan Three-Bedroom Pool Villa with Sea View, Bophut
blurb: A contemporary three-bedroom, four-bathroom pool villa in a small gated enclave in Bophut, five minutes from Fisherman's Village and close to Bundara and Anantara Bophut. Two storeys over a lower service level, with open-plan living, a European kitchen, a private infinity pool and sea views from the upper floors. Freehold (Chanote) or 90-year leasehold at ฿17,500,000, off-plan with roughly 12 months to completion — and a ฿1,000,000 special discount on reservations made by November 2026.
detail:
A PRIVATE HILLSIDE ENCLAVE IN BOPHUT
Set in a small gated development 200 m back from the island ring road in Bophut, on Koh Samui's north-east coast, this contemporary villa is five minutes from the restaurants, bars and beach of Fisherman's Village, with no steep hill on the way in. Bundara and Anantara Bophut are close by, and beaches, international schools, hospitals and the airport are all within a quarter of an hour. Ten villas share the plot across two designs — Icon and Paragon — at different stages of construction.

THE VILLA
Clean architectural lines, open-plan living and an easy indoor–outdoor flow. The lower level holds parking, the pump room, laundry and storage. The middle floor has two en-suite bedrooms with sea views, a living area and a covered front terrace with a guest WC. The top floor is the heart of the home: open-plan living and dining with a European kitchen opening onto the private infinity pool (3.2 × 7.5 m, 1.2 m deep), plus the master suite with a bathtub and rain shower, both taking in the sea view. Air-conditioning in every bedroom and the living area, ceiling fans throughout and an EV charging point at the parking.

PRICE LIST
Icon I-10 / I-11 — sea view from the 2nd floor · off-plan, approx. 12 months — ฿15,900,000
Icon I-14 / I-15 — sea view from the top floor · approx. 30% built, approx. 9 months to handover — ฿16,500,000
Paragon P-14 — sea view from the top floor · off-plan, approx. 12 months — ฿16,500,000
Paragon P-15 — sea view from the top floor · approx. 80% built, ready within 3 months — ฿16,500,000
Paragon P-16 / P-18 / P-19 — sea view from the upper floors · off-plan, approx. 12 months — ฿17,500,000

This listing is for Paragon P-16, P-18 and P-19 — 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, about 341 m² of building area on plots of 234–252 m². A special discount of ฿1,000,000 applies to reservations made by November 2026. An optional furniture package is available for ฿1,500,000. Floor plans for all three units are at the end of the gallery.

RENTAL POTENTIAL
Fully furnished, a villa of this kind is estimated to rent for around ฿200,000 a month (about ฿2,400,000 a year) — roughly a 13% gross annual return on the furnished price.

PAYMENT PLAN
A ฿300,000 deposit secures the unit, with the contract signed within 30 days; the balance is staged through construction:
30% — Land sale and purchase agreement
20% — Building contract
10% — Ground-floor structure and pool structure
10% — Columns, roof beams, roof structure and tiling
10% — Walls, electrical and sanitary systems
10% — Plastering, ceilings and tiling
5% — Aluminium doors and windows
5% — Electrical fittings, sanitaryware, kitchen, water and pool systems
Prices exclude 7% VAT.

OWNERSHIP, WARRANTY & RUNNING COSTS
Freehold (Chanote) or 90-year leasehold. Freehold transfer taxes and fees run to roughly 5.5% of the land price (typically under ฿100,000); leasehold registration is about 1.1% of the lease value (typically under ฿40,000) — both usually split between buyer and seller. A 5-year structural warranty and 1-year warranty on water and electrical equipment are included. Government electricity; deep-well water (฿120 per unit, with truck supply in the dry season) plus a government water connection, tank and pump. The common fee is about ฿5,000–5,500 a month, covering common lighting, refuse collection, CCTV, estate cleaning and a security post.

KEY FACTS
5 min to Fisherman's Village & Wattanapat Hospital · 10 min to the beach & Samui International School · 12 min to Lotus's & Makro · 15 min to Bangkok Hospital Samui & the airport
3 bedrooms · 4 bathrooms · private infinity pool · sea views from the upper floors
Off-plan, approx. 12 months to completion
Price: ฿17,500,000 (฿1,000,000 discount until November 2026)
